reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Dashboards or single panels as PDF or CSV by mail, on a schedule.
reports.filter.label: Filter reports
reports.menu.label: Actions for {name}
reports.delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
reports.delete.text: The report and its runs are deleted.
reports.send.title: Send “{name}” now?
reports.send.text: Goes to all recipients ({count}) at once, as saved.
reports.suspended.name: {name} is suspended:
reports.suspended.hint: It runs again once the right is back; a copy runs with your rights.
reports.empty.title: No reports yet
reports.empty.text: Send a dashboard or single panels by mail regularly, say Mondays at 7.
reports.tip: Tip: send a new report to yourself only at first and look at two or three runs.
reports.forbidden.title: Reports are not open to you
reports.noMail.title: Reports need a mail server
reports.noMail.text: None is set up on this server (Settings > Email).
reports.notFound: This report does not exist, or you cannot see it.
reports.pausedNote: Paused; runs are not made up.
reports.conflict: Someone changed the report in the meantime.
reports.name: Name
reports.range.hint: Counted from the run, in the time zone of the report.
reports.schedule.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday.
reports.recipients.hint: Everyone must be able to read “{dashboard}”.
reports.recipients.external: Outside addresses get the attachments only, no links.
reports.format.pdfNote: A4 landscape, close to the interface, not pixel-identical.
reports.format.csvNote: CSV for tables only; document and graph panels need a step that makes a table. Without data:export and to outside addresses only the PDF goes.
reports.language.hint: For the PDF and the mail.
reports.preview.title: Preview: {name}
reports.preview.note: With the data of now and your rights; nothing is sent. Close to the interface, not pixel-identical.
reports.rights.yours: Runs with your rights, checked at every run; if one is missing, it is suspended.
reports.rights.owner: Runs with the rights of {name}; editing does not change that.
reports.rights.notOwner: Only {name} or an organization admin can change, send or delete this report; you can pause it.
reports.rights.notOwnerPaused: Only {name} or an organization admin can change, resume, send or delete this report.
reports.runs.noneYet: No run yet. The next one: {at}.
reports.runs.footer: Runs are kept for {days} days. Kalzit does not store the attachments.
reports.reason.dashboard_unknown: This dashboard does not exist, or you cannot read it.
reports.reason.time_invalid: The time of day looks like 08:00.
reports.reason.cron_invalid: The expression needs five valid fields.
reports.reason.schedule_too_frequent: A report runs every 15 minutes at most.
reports.reason.not_owner: Only the person who created this report or an organization admin can change, send or delete it.
reports.reason.recipient_unknown: This person is no member any more.
reports.reason.recipient_duplicate: This recipient is already on the list.
reports.reason.recipient_email_invalid: Neither a person of the organization nor an email address.
reports.reason.recipient_is_account: The address belongs to an account; add the person.
reports.reason.external_not_allowed: Outside recipients are off in this organization.
reports.reason.external_domain_not_allow: The domain of this address is not allowed.
reports.reason.too_many: The organization already has its {max} reports.
reports.reason.disabled: Reports are turned off here; existing ones stay and wait.
reports.reason.mail_not_configured: No mail server is set up.
reports.reason.rate_limited: Too many runs or previews; try again in a moment.
reports.reason.attachment_too_large: The files are too large for a mail.
reports.reason.creator_gone: The person is no longer in the organization.
reports.reason.creator_no_permission: The person lacks the permission reports:write.
reports.reason.creator_no_dashboard: The person can no longer read the dashboard.
reports.reason.creator_no_export: The person lacks the permission data:export for CSV.
reports.reason.render_failed: The files could not be made.
reports.reason.nothing_to_send: There was neither a PDF nor a table for CSV.
reports.reason.no_recipients: No recipient may get the report right now.
reports.reason.all_refused: The mail server refused every recipient.
reports.reason.internal: A fault on the server (see its log).
reports.reason.interrupted: The server stopped during the run.
reports.reason.missed: No server ran at the scheduled time.
reports.reason.queue_late: The run waited too long for its turn.
reports.recipients.gone: No longer in the organization, dropped on save: {count}
reports.reason.panel_unknown: A chosen panel is no longer on the dashboard.
reports.reason.time_unit_unsupported: Fiscal years and quarters do not work in reports.
reports.reason.time_range_reversed: The time range ends before it starts.
reports.reason.results_too_large: The results are too large for a report.
reports.reason.panel_link_missing: A library panel or a saved analysis is missing.
